name: erinne
description: Search your Erinne documents (inbox and shared libraries) from Claude, with citations.
long_description: Lets Claude search the documents you can see in Erinne and answer with the file, page and section for every claim, linking back to Erinne. Read-only. Uses a personal token you create under Claude in Erinne; what Claude may search is set by Erinne's admins.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search your documents and return cited passages

tools.name: read_passage
tools.description: Read a passage with the text around it

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List your inbox and the libraries you can search

tools.name: browse_folder
tools.description: List the folders and files in a library

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find files and folders by name

api_token.title: Erinne token
api_token.description: Create one in Erinne under Claude → Create token, then paste it here.

erinne_url.description: Where Erinne runs. Leave as is unless an admin tells you otherwise.
